title: Projects I Wouldn't Use Python For in 2026
excerpt: Highly irregular postings about technology and life
content_html:
About / Projects / Talks / Tags

Posted on July 28, 2026

I owe much of my career to Python and I used to choose Python for everything ... but now I don't. I gave a talk about this topic at the July 2026 Christchurch Python NZ meetup, a risky move for a Python meetup.

This talk starts with my early adoption of Python and the subsequent decades of using it for almost everything. It then moves into why Python isn't always the best choice and what I now often use instead. I still love Python though and the presentation finishes with where I think Python still shines.

If you're interested, the slides are here.

发表于 2026 年 7 月 28 日

我的职业生涯很大程度上归功于 Python，我曾经选择 Python 来做所有事情...... 但现在我不知道了。 我在 2026 年 7 月的基督城 Python 新西兰聚会上就这个主题发表了演讲，这对于 Python 聚会来说是一个冒险的举动。

本次演讲从我早期采用 Python 以及随后几十年将它用于几乎所有事情开始。 然后讨论为什么 Python 并不总是最佳选择以及我现在经常使用的替代方案。 不过，我仍然喜欢 Python，并且演示结束时我认为 Python 仍然闪闪发光。
